question.text: A transistor is connected in common emitter circuit configuration, the collector supply voltage is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>10</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> and the voltage drop across a resistor of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1000</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math> in the collector circuit is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>6</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>.</mo></math> If the current gain factor <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>)</mo></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>24</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the base current is ____<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>μA</mi></math>. (Round off to the Nearest Integer)
